commentStyle.description:
- `normalize`: Normalize comment text according to Tombi's formatting rules.
- `preserve`: Preserve the original comment text while formatting its placement normally.
commentStyle.title: The style used to format comments

dateTimeDelimiter.description:
In accordance with [RFC 3339](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc3339), you can use `T` or space character between date and time.

- `T`: Use `T` between date and time like `2001-01-01T00:00:00`
- `space`: Use space between date and time like `2001-01-01 00:00:00`
- `preserve`: Preserve the original delimiter.
dateTimeDelimiter.title: The delimiter between date and time

groupBlankLinesLimit.description:
Consecutive groups remain separate for sorting purposes,
and existing blank lines between them are preserved up to this limit.

```toml
# BEFORE
key1 = "value1"
key2 = "value2"

key3 = "value3"


key4 = "value4"

# AFTER (`group-blank-lines-limit = 1`)
key1 = "value1"
key2 = "value2"

key3 = "value3"

key4 = "value4"
```
groupBlankLinesLimit.title: The blank lines limit between groups.

indentStyle.description:
Whether to use spaces or tabs for indentation.

- `space`: Use spaces for indentation.
- `tab`: Use tabs for indentation.
indentStyle.title: The style of indentation

indentSubTables.description:
If `true`, the sub-table will be indented.

```toml
[table]
    [table.sub-table]
    key = "value"
# ^^  <- this
```
indentSubTables.title: Whether to indent the sub-tables

indentTableKeyValuePairs.description:
If `true`, the table key-value pairs will be indented.

```toml
[table]
    key = "value"
# ^^  <- this
```
indentTableKeyValuePairs.title: Whether to indent the table key-value pairs

indentWidth.description:
⚠️ **WARNING** ⚠️\
This option is only used when the indentation style is `space`.
indentWidth.title: The number of spaces per indentation level

inlineTableBraceSpaceWidth.title: The number of spaces inside the brackets of a single line inline table.

inlineTableCommaSpaceWidth.title: The number of spaces after the comma in a single line inline table.

keyQuoteStyle.description:
Choose which quote style the formatter prefers for quoted keys.
If unspecified, `string-quote-style` is used.
keyQuoteStyle.title: The preferred quote character for keys

keyValueEqualsSignAlignment.description:
If `true`, the equals sign in the key-value pairs will be aligned.

⚠️ **WARNING** ⚠️\
This feature does **not** apply to key-value pairs inside single line inline tables.

```toml
# BEFORE
key = "value1"
key2 = "value2"
key3.key4 = "value3"

# AFTER
key       = "value1"
key2      = "value2"
key3.key4 = "value3"
```
keyValueEqualsSignAlignment.title: Whether to align the equals sign in the key-value pairs.

keyValueEqualsSignSpaceWidth.title: The number of spaces around the equals sign in a key-value pair.

lineEnding.description:
In TOML, the line ending must be either `LF` or `CRLF`.

- `lf`: Line Feed only (`\n`), common on Linux and macOS as well as inside git repos.
- `crlf`: Carriage Return Line Feed (`\r\n`), common on Windows.
lineEnding.title: The type of line ending

lineWidth.description:
The formatter will try to keep lines within this width when specified.
If omitted, there is no line-width limit.
lineWidth.title: The maximum line width

stringQuoteStyle.description: Choose which quote style the formatter prefers for basic strings.
stringQuoteStyle.title: The preferred quote character for strings

tableBlankLines.description:
This applies when the formatter inserts spacing between table or array-of-table blocks.

```toml
# BEFORE
[aaa]
key1 = "value1"
[bbb]
key2 = "value2"

# AFTER (`table-blank-lines = 2`)
[aaa]
key1 = "value1"


[bbb]
key2 = "value2"
```

Tight parent/child table adjacency is controlled separately, so this does not apply
when a child table follows a parent table that has no key-value pairs.

```toml
# BEFORE
[aaa]

[aaa.bbb]

# AFTER
[aaa]
[aaa.bbb]
```
tableBlankLines.title: The number of blank lines between tables.

tomlVersion.description: The TOML language version. Document directives may override it.

trailingCommentAlignment.description:
If `true`, the trailing comments in value/key-value pairs will be aligned.

**📝 NOTE 📝**\
The trailing comments of table header are not targeted by alignment.

```toml
# BEFORE
key = "value1"  # comment 1
key2 = "value2"  # comment 2
key3.key4 = "value3"  # comment 3

# AFTER
key = "value1"        # comment 1
key2 = "value2"       # comment 2
key3.key4 = "value3"  # comment 3
```
trailingCommentAlignment.title: Whether to align the trailing comments in the key-value pairs.

trailingCommentSpaceWidth.title: The number of spaces before the trailing comment.
